test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 30 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution: The correct answer is **"stress."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Stress"** is the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3. • **"Stress" **refers to a state of mental or emotional strain or tension resulting from adverse or demanding circumstances. (प्रतिकूल या मांगलिक परिस्थितियों से उत्पन्न मानसिक या भावनात्मक दबाव या तनाव की स्थिति) • **Example**: *He’s been under a lot of **stress**__ since his wife went into hospital.* • The correct answer is Option 1. • Correct passage: Isolation and loneliness __caused__ by the Covid-19 pandemic and lockdown policies negatively __impacted__ the mental health of the public throughout the entire globe. These result in an increase in emotional __**stress**__, ______ (4) ______ of hopelessness and extreme anxiety, which are ______ (5) ______ by variations in emotional responses and style of living. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 2, "anxiety"**, refers to a feeling of worry, nervousness, or unease about something with an uncertain outcome. (भय, चिंता या अनिश्‍चय की भावना विशेषतः भविष्‍य के प्रति) • **Option 3, "death"**, refers to the end of life or the cessation of all biological functions that sustain a living organism. (जीवन की समाप्ति; मृत्‍यु) • **Option 4, "state"**, in this context, does not fit grammatically or semantically as it is too broad and vague to convey a specific meaning. ((समय-विशेष पर किसी की मानसिक, भावनात्‍मक या शारीरिक दशा, अवस्‍था)) 1e6:Td49, The correct answer is **"feelings."**
